experiment.hypothesis: ResNet18 with reduced regularization (dropout 0.25, wd 0.005, ls 0.03) and lower LR (1.5e-4) will exceed 0.996 val accuracy by allowing sharper decision boundaries and more complete convergence on the 28x28 histopathology task where local texture features dominate.

decision.rationale: ResNet18 dominates all transformer variants (0.9959 vs 0.9917 best). t0007 was still improving at epoch 29 (0.9961). Refining: lower LR (1.5e-4) for finer convergence, reduced label smoothing (0.03) for sharper boundaries, lower weight decay (0.005) and dropout (0.25) to reduce over-regularization, extended to 60 epochs with patience 15 for full convergence.
